session.unmapped: Your account is not linked to a subject of the learning policy. Ask an administrator to add it to the identity map.
session.unavailable: The studio cannot reach the authoring service. Try again in a moment.

signIn.title: Sign in to the studio
signIn.body: Sign in with your organisation account. The studio never sees your password; your session ends when you sign out or when it expires.

home.title: Studio
home.intro: Create a course, see a course as a whole, and review the proposals that await a person.
home.contextHint: The id of the execution context, as given to the CLI with --context.
home.contextRequired: Enter the id of a context.
home.createIntro: A new course starts empty, in preparation. You become its administrator; nobody else can see it yet.
home.courseHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example prompting-basics.
home.courseRequired: Enter the id of the new course.
home.createForbidden: You may not create courses. Ask an operator to add you to the course template.
home.createConflict: This id is already in use: {{detail}}
home.createInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, at most 64 characters.
home.createFailed: The course could not be created. Try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is no studio page at this address.

inbox.title: Review inbox
inbox.approvedEmpty: No approved proposal waits to be applied.

errors.unavailable: This context is not available. Check its id, or ask an operator whether its policy is installed.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to review this context.
errors.failed: The review service did not answer. Try again in a moment.

status.stale: Stale: the context changed before application

proposal.title: Review a proposal
proposal.notFound: There is no proposal {{proposal}} in this context.
proposal.notPending: This proposal does not await a decision. Its status is: {{status}}.

changes.heading: Changes against the applied version
changes.intro: Each record of the proposal is compared with the version of the same record that is applied in the context now.
changes.noDifference: No field differs from the applied version.
changes.notApplied: The context has no version of this record yet.

payload.heading: Exact payload
payload.intro: The proposal and its records exactly as the decision will cover them.

decision.heading: Decision
decision.reasonRequired: Write the reason for the decision.
decision.conflict: This proposal changed after you opened it, so your decision was not recorded. The page now shows its current state; review it again.
decision.forbidden: You are not allowed to decide this proposal. Nothing was recorded.
decision.failed: The decision may not have been recorded. The page now shows the current state.

apply.heading: Application
apply.intro: The proposal is approved but not applied. Applying it changes the context; it is a separate step from the approval.
apply.applied: Change applied. The context is now at version {{version}}.
apply.conflict: The proposal can no longer be applied as approved: {{detail}} The page now shows its current state.
apply.forbidden: You are not allowed to apply this proposal. Nothing was changed.
apply.failed: The application did not complete. Try again: the retry repeats the same operation, so the change is applied at most once.

teacher.otherProposal: This proposal has no student activity or assessment content. What it changes is listed in the technical details.

changes.heading: What changes
changes.none: The teaching content is the same as the version in use now. Only internal links and versions change; they are listed in the technical details.

change.newActivity: A new student activity is added.
change.newRequirement: A new resource requirement is added: {{value}}
change.purpose: The purpose of a resource requirement changes.

students.heading: What students would be asked to do

issues.heading: To check before deciding
issues.none: Nothing to check: no problem was reported.
issues.source: In the course and its source material, not caused by this proposal ({{found}})

issue.generated: “{{name}}” does not fit the course model ({{field}}): {{detail}}
issue.notAllowed: “{{name}}”: the {{field}} “{{value}}” is not one of the allowed values ({{allowed}}).

technical.heading: Technical details
technical.intro: The exact records, their identifiers and a field-by-field comparison, for administrators. The decision covers exactly this payload.

course.title: Course
course.notVisible: The course content of this context is not visible to you.
course.review_one: Review inbox: {{count}} proposal awaits a decision
course.review_other: Review inbox: {{count}} proposals await a decision

structure.heading: Structure
structure.intro: Phases and units in their order, with the activities of each.
structure.empty: The learning design has no structure yet.

history.heading: History
history.intro: Every proposal made for this course, newest first, with its decisions and its application.

course.notStarted: This course has no syllabus yet.
course.build: Build the course from an AIM-PRO model

build.title: Build the course
build.intro: Start the course from an AIM-PRO model: upload it, let the Curator draft a syllabus, review it, then initialize the project.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this in this course.
errors.failed: The request did not complete. Try again.

upload.heading: 1. Upload the AIM-PRO model
upload.intro: The file is checked and kept exactly as you send it; it is never edited.
upload.fileHint: The JSON file exported from jjodel (megamodel format 1.0).
upload.scenarioHint: The name of the scenario model in the export.
upload.scenarioRequired: Enter the name of the scenario.
upload.competenciesHint: The name of the competency model in the export.
upload.competenciesRequired: Enter the name of the competency catalogue.
upload.stored: The model was accepted and stored unchanged.
upload.conforms: The scenario fits the course model.
upload.notConforms: The scenario does not fully fit the course model. You can still continue: the problems below go with the syllabus to its review.
upload.contractIssues: Does not fit the course model ({{found}})

curator.heading: 2. Draft the syllabus with the Curator
curator.intro: The Curator reads the uploaded model and the sources found for your query, and proposes a syllabus. Nothing changes until you approve it.
curator.scopeHint: The collection of sources this course may search, as named in its policy.
curator.queryHint: What the sources should be about, in a few words.
curator.running: The Curator is drafting the syllabus…
curator.proposed: The syllabus is ready and waits for your review.
curator.abandoned: The job was abandoned by an administrator.
curator.ended: The Curator did not propose a syllabus: {{detail}}

project.heading: 3. Initialize the project
project.intro: Once the syllabus is applied, the project gathers what the next steps build on: assessments, materials and the release.
project.label: Project id
project.hint: A short name for the project, for example main.
project.proposed: The project is proposed and waits for your review.
